body: A decision engine that returns typed choices, scores, or yes/no answers from text in a single forward pass.
plain_description: **Turn text and other inputs into fast, structured decisions for your business.** Route requests, score urgency, or flag risks across 100+ languages. Teach it from confirmed answers on your own machine.
technical_description: Laya is an open-source, multilingual decision engine for typed choice, score, and yes/no decisions. It processes text, images, audio, and video, with routing across checkpoints and optional learning from confirmed answers. It provides Python and other language SDKs, a CLI, an optional web playground and JSON API, and self-hosted HTTP and MCP servers. Fine-tuning is also available.
title: Laya
